caveats: Based on historical 2020–2024 patterns, not a model of future conditions.
Reflects regular-season games, not Olympic-scale crowds — 2028 conditions will differ.
2020 home games were played with little or no crowd and are included in this comparison.
The 800 m buffer counts LAPD reports on surrounding streets, not a list of incidents inside the stadium.
Every upcoming date uses the same historical lift. It is not a separate estimate for that date.
Read the percentage next to the daily means. A large percentage can still be less than one additional report per day.
Offense groups whose game-day and other-day means differ by under 0.05 reports per day do not get a percentage.
Category tests are separate and are not adjusted for the number of groups.
Compared with other days in the same months as completed regular-season home games, 2020–2024. Winter days outside those months are not the baseline.
1 upcoming listing is a possible postseason game. The lift was estimated from regular-season home games.
Ticketmaster places these listings about 907 m from the project venue coordinate, outside the 800 m crime buffer. The lift still uses that project buffer.
